module_summary: Six-state Moore FSM steered by input w with synchronous reset; output z decoded high in states E and F.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-bit state register for states A-F, transitions chosen by w; decodes z.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state, high in states E and F.

groups.name: fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic on w, state register and Moore output decode for z.
